name: Where Seasons Pass [BETA]
desc:
Watch all the four seasons pass every week in this farming game. Grow and discover over 30 unique crops, decorate your farm with countless cosmetics, or spontaneously decide to start a beekeeping business and sell honey! Create a place that feels truly your own all while everything around you changes... 🌷☀️🍂❄️ 

🔨 Where Seasons Pass is currently in Beta. Features are still unfinished and change as we continue to develop the game. Please be mindful that bugs may occur, please report them.

⊹ New code at 25,000 likes
✿ 20,000 likes ("BusyBee")
✿ 15,000 likes ("IHitTheGoal")

🍀 In this gardening game, there are 38 unique seasonal quests to complete, name titles to collect, all while being able expand your farm with beautiful greenhouses, plants, and many decorations! 
🐝Become a Beekeeper and sell honey that your bees produce from your beautiful flowers.
